title: Boktai 2: Solar Boy Django
subtitle: The solar hunter returns home
summary: Boktai 2: Solar Boy Django is Konami's Game Boy Advance action role-playing sequel bringing Django back to San Miguel. A vampire steals the Gun Del Sol, leaving the returning hunter to find another way of fighting while investigating what has happened to his home. The cartridge retains the light sensor that connects real sunlight with the adventure's resources. The new situation changes how that central idea is used, giving a familiar hero a reason to learn different equipment before he can recover the weapon that defined his first journey through the darkness.
body: Boktai 2: Solar Boy Django is Konami's Game Boy Advance action role-playing sequel bringing Django back to San Miguel. A vampire steals the Gun Del Sol, leaving the returning hunter to find another way of fighting while investigating what has happened to his home. The cartridge retains the light sensor that connects real sunlight with the adventure's resources. The new situation changes how that central idea is used, giving a familiar hero a reason to learn different equipment before he can recover the weapon that defined his first journey through the darkness.

Zazie gives Django the Sol de Vice, a glove capable of imbuing ordinary weapons with solar power. A sword can therefore become part of the same relationship between daylight and the undead that previously centred on the gun. The change broadens the physical form of combat while keeping the sensor relevant to preparation. Django's new tools need to be understood on their own terms, making the loss of his original weapon a practical change to the adventure rather than only a story event that leaves the player's available actions untouched.

San Miguel provides the setting for Django's search for answers, including the disappearance of the blacksmith Smith and reports of the vampire passing through. Following these leads connects individual expeditions with the condition of a place the protagonist already knows. The solar sensor keeps the surrounding real world involved while the town supplies a more personal reason to continue. The sequel builds on the original game's unusual cartridge through that changed context, giving daylight another set of weapons to power and giving the hunter a home whose problems make the next journey worth undertaking.
story_headings: The sunlight moves into another weapon
The town gives the investigation a centre
